visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-angle close-up of a white plate containing sliced poached chicken with yellow skin and boiled cabbage. A tortoiseshell cat is hunched over the plate, its face buried in the food. A man's hand enters from the top of the frame, repeatedly grabbing the cat's head and scruff to pull it away from the chicken. The cat persists in pushing back toward the plate. (2) The camera pulls back slightly to reveal the environment. A black desk is visible with a mechanical keyboard featuring red and purple RGB backlighting. In the background, two monitors show YouTube video interfaces with various thumbnails and text. The man's hand continues to gently shove the cat's face away as it attempts to sniff the food. (3) The shot remains stable on the cat and the plate. The cat finally pulls its head back slightly as the hand keeps it at a distance, though the cat still looks intently at the chicken. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused, highlighting the oily texture of the chicken.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a humorous and relatable interaction between a pet owner and their greedy cat. The primary intent is to share the cat's stubborn behavior as it tries to steal food (poached chicken) from the owner's meal, highlighting the cat's persistence and the owner's gentle struggle to maintain order.
